ValidationRule.description: The Recommended Actions field must have a value if "Continued Enrollment" is the type.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK( Recommended_Actions__c), OR( ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Conferred with Student by Phone'), ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Conferred with Student by Email'), ISPICKVAL( Status , 'In Person Meeting') ), RecordTypeId = '012d00000021xGK' )
